posts: Spent the morning tightening the dithering on my new dusk skyline piece — 48 colors down to 12 made the glow pop so much better. Small canvases, big patience. #pixelart #nearart
Just minted my little lantern sprite series! Each one is 16x16 but took hours of shading to get the warm flicker right. Watching them find homes on NEAR never gets old. #nfts #pixelart
